programme.title: Pizzapalooza
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde is throwin’ down a pizza spread like never before with his Chicago-style tavern pie with sausage & onion, a grilled pizza pocket with pepperoni & cheese, chicken wings a la pizzaiola, and a zesty grilled caesar salad to finish it off.

programme.title: The Art of Open Fire Cooking
programme.desc: Chef Dale goes back to the roots of cooking, building a grill over an open fire to serve up a variety of dishes, including whole smoked chicken and fish, roasted cauliflower, a sweet and tangy grilled pineapple s’more dessert.

programme.title: Yakitori and More-Y
programme.desc: Don’t sleep on grilled chicken, especially if it’s Chef Dale night to cook! He’s serving up Japanese style yakitori three ways, from spicy to sweet to zesty, with crispy rice, and of course he adds his own flair to these delicious skewered snacks.

programme.title: Wok Cooking On A Charcoal Grill
programme.desc: Anything is possible with a wok and a good ol’ charcoal grill, at least if you’re Chef Dale, who throws together a heavenly spread of fiery eats, from drunken meats, stir fried veggies, and stir fried noodles

programme.title: Caribbean Latin BBQ
programme.desc: Comforting and familiar but full of island flavor, right from the grill! Chef Dale roasts pork shoulder with chicharrones, steamy coconut rice and pigeon peas finished with frozen coconut rum drank with a charred banana.

programme.title: World of Burgers!
programme.desc: It’s burger day! Chef Dale tackles three classics with a full flavor spin. Game changing Pho Burgers with bone marrow, toasted milk bread Ahi Tuna patty melts, and Chori Pan Burgers with a fried egg and shrimp chips.

programme.title: Game Day
programme.desc: Frankie throws a game day party for under $25. He makes three no-fuss appetizers that are cheaper, healthier, and tastier than subpar game day take out. So gather around with friends and cheer on your favorite teams. Or just eat. Both are a win.

programme.title: Winter is Here
programme.desc: It’s the dead of winter in Frankie’s kitchen, which means it’s that time for hearty, delicious, and warming homemade meals. So you’re saving more money, while you’re staying in, already saving money. It’s a winter miracle.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Frankie prepares a Valentine’s Day dinner for under $15. Why go to a crowded restaurant for an overpriced prix-fixe menu when you can prep a simple yet decadent romantic meal at home? It’ll be sweet, it’ll be aphrodisiacal, and it’ll be sexy cheap.

programme.title: Beans Beans Beans
programme.desc: Frankie will teach the basics of preparing beans from scratch while making super tasty recipes. Beans are the gift that keeps on giving, so don’t be scared to eat too many. Remember, they’re good for your heart.

programme.title: Rent Week
programme.desc: It’s the first of the month, when you spend your whole paycheck on rent and bills. Your fridge is looking pretty sad and the grocery budget is low. Frankie cooks up some go-to pantry meals and teaches us how to better prep for this time of the month.

programme.title: Mushroom Mania
programme.desc: Frankie takes us on a magical mushroom trip. They’re an affordable plant-based meat replacement, packed with nutritional value. We’ll learn all things mushrooms and how to make inventive, flavorful dishes that might trip you out on their awesomeness.

programme.title: Spring Fling

programme.title: Grilled Loco Moco and Huli Huli Chicken
programme.desc: The options are plentiful when Chef Dale smothers grilled Loco Moco with a mushroom gravy, salty and sweet Huli Huli Chicken with charred pineapple, and healthy scoops of Tuna Water Chestnut poke or mac salad.

programme.title: Street Eats off the Grill
programme.desc: Japan, Thailand, Turkey, and Mexico street foods inspire Dale to grill with dynamically preparing Chili-Cuman Lamb Mushroom sticks, Grilled pork and shrimp shumai, and scallion pancakes with brown butter labneh.

programme.title: Sizzlin' Summer Fruits
programme.desc: Summertime seasonal fruit pampers your tastebuds. Chef Dale grills blistered grapes with ham wrapped Trout, Peaches with smoked Pork Chops, Watermelon with halloumi, and Chargrilled Cherries with chocolate Mousse.

programme.title: Ribs Remix
programme.desc: Ribs are a lifestyle, and Chef Dale’s living it up with smoky beef shorties in tangy red wine glaze, Miami-style pork ribs dripping in bacon-guava BBQ, spicy baked beans, and killer key lime caramel cones. Grab some napkins!

programme.title: Bussin' Burgers
programme.desc: Chef Dale is flipping burgers into art - gooey mac & cheese burgers, fancy French patties topped with melty bucheron cheese, crispy parm-truffle fries, and peanut butter fudge ice cream sandwiches. Get hungry.

programme.title: The Heat Is On
programme.desc: Dale’s turning up the heat! Carolina Reaper wings hotter than your ex, sweet-chili NY strip steak, smoky grilled chipotle Texas toast, and ancho-gochujang pineapple skillet cake for dessert. Bring some water!

programme.title: Tandoor On The Grill
programme.desc: Dale fires up the tandoor grill, turning out juicy chicken thighs, smoky shrimp with Old Bay yogurt, crispy cauliflower, and a silky mango lassi dessert topped with crunchy candied pistachios. Tandoori done right!

programme.title: Kabob-alicious
programme.desc: Chef Dale proves food on a stick is unbeatable—soy-sesame ribeye skewers, chipotle salmon, smoky eggplant dip with crispy beans, and coriander-honey peaches grilled to juicy perfection. Stick around!

programme.title: Taco Like It's Hot
programme.desc: Taco night, Dale-style! Puffy al pastor tacos stuffed with pineapple-chile pork, grilled chicken pepian with charred tomato sauce, crispy street corn ribs, and dulce de leche empanadas. Taco Tuesday who?

programme.title: Pizza-Town
programme.desc: Dale reinvents pizza night: grilled pizza bagels loaded with pepperoni, mozzarella-stuffed penne vodka pie, a massive grilled chop salad, and olive oil cake with burnt orange caramel. Pizza goals achieved.

programme.title: Warm + Cozy Winter
programme.desc: Frankie gets cozy in the Struggle kitchen with recipes that bring all the warmth, flavor and joy during the coldest days of winter. From a casual weekday dinner to a special weekend meal, these dishes are sure to keep you warm and cozy.

programme.title: Eggscellent Techniques
programme.desc: In this special technique episode, Frankie teaches us several methods for cooking a quintessential ingredient: eggs. The scramble, the omelet, the Benedict – learn to make them just the way you like them.

programme.title: Vintage
programme.desc: Frankie cooks his way back in time with his favorite vintage recipes. These oldie-but-goodie dishes are not only nostalgic and comforting, but they’ll also fill you up without costing you a pretty penny.

programme.title: Struggle Soup
programme.desc: Warm and hearty bowls of veggies, beans, pasta, and more, these soups will have you returning for seconds all year round. Frankie’s soup blueprints can turn everyday ingredients into extraordinary soups, with endless flavor opportunity.

programme.title: Struggle Sandwich
programme.desc: In a sandwich, every component plays a role. With a supporting cast of fixin’s, and Frankie’s cost-saving homemade twists, these sandwiches just might steal the show.

programme.title: Cabbage, cabbage, cabbage
programme.desc: Cabbage has long been an underrated green on the field, and it’s about time Frankie gives it a starring role. This leafy head proves itself as the versatile ingredient we need it to be, affordable year around, delicious and filling.

programme.title: Mayo: The Secret Ingredient
programme.desc: Who knew mayo could be such a savvy secret agent? It’s a controversial condiment that can unlock the buttery, crispy, decadent codes of our favorite dishes, without leaving a trace of mayo-ness. Best of all, it’s easy to make at home!

programme.title: Crunchy
programme.desc: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

programme.title: A Cruciferous Delicious Time
programme.desc: No veggie family packs the same nutritious punch as the cruciferous family, and with a shelf life this long, they’ve become a fixture in Frankie’s meal rotation. These delicious and easy-to-make recipes will win everyone over in no time.

programme.title: 5-Ingredient Recipes
programme.desc: Who said struggle meals can’t be delicious? Don’t sleep on these 5-ingredient recipes – simple weeknight meals that are anything but boring, and with a few pantry staples, you’ll have dinner on the table in no time.

programme.title: Summer BBQ

programme.title: Crunchy
programme.desc: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

programme.title: Jerkin' and GRILLIN'
programme.desc: Back from a trip to Negril, Jamaica, chef Derrell Smith brings his favorite dishes back to his own yard! Grillin’ up Jerk Chicken, Saltfish and Ackee, coconut peas and rice and other Caribbean favorites for his two friends.

programme.title: Happy Birthday to Me
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith’s birthday and he’s treating himself to some self love and a lavish steak dinner inspired by a famous NYC steakhouse. On the menu: Rib Eye Steak with Peppercorn Sauce, Duck Frites, Wedge Salad and a celebratory carrot cake.

programme.title: Brunch Grows Up
programme.desc: Enough with the endless lines and mimosas! Chef Derrell Smith has leveled up his brunch by hosting his own. Today's menu, a "yelluh" grit bowl bar with toppings; Beer Braised Pulled Pork, Chili Fried Eggs, Bang Bang Shrimp and Tajin-rimmed Palomas.

programme.title: Grandma Estelle
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith’s grandma inspired him in life and in the kitchen. He shares family recipes taking him right back to grandma's table. He's cookin' up Fried Chicken, Mac ‘N Cheese, Collard Green Slaw, Brûlée Banana Pudding and Pop-pops moonshine.

programme.title: Weeknight Noodles
programme.desc: Chef Noah Galuten cooks up a collection of easy and satisfying pasta dishes quick enough for weeknights. Don't Panic!

programme.title: Grilling and Smoking
programme.desc: Chef Noah Galuten grills up a perfect yet simple burger topped with cheddar, lettuce, onion and his 'special sauce'. Don't Panic!

programme.title: Christmas Special
programme.desc: Chef Noah Galuten celebrates Christmas with his twist on the traditional "Feast of the Seven Fishes" including ceviche, crudo, oysters and more! Don't Panic!

programme.title: Grandmas Pizza
programme.desc: Chef Noah Galuten cooks classic Grandma style pizza including homemade dough, sauce and more. Don't Panic!

programme.title: A Journey to Salad Town
programme.desc: Salads can be way more fun! Come to Salad Town, for Mustard-Shallot Vinaigrette; Probiotic Ranch with Cheddar Croutons; a no-measure salad when for when you’re in a rush; and the crunchy, crispy, acidic, cheesy, Chopped Salad of your dreams.

programme.title: Rustic Comfort Pastas
programme.desc: Perfect Pantry Puttanesca is packed with more flavor than you could ever hope for; a Rustic Pork Ragu will make you wonder why anyone ever makes Bolognese: and a Vegetarian Mushroom Ragu will make you wonder why anyone ever eats meat.

programme.title: How have you bean?
programme.desc: Beans are one of the best foods in the world. They are sustainable to grow, great for your nutrition, affordable and delicious. So in this episode, we're taking a deep dive into beans!

programme.title: The Sandwich Episode
programme.desc: This is.... THE SANDWICH EPISODE, featuring "The Bear" culinary producer Courtney Storer. Courtney and Noah recreate the iconic steak sandwich from the beloved tv series.

programme.title: The Soup Episode
programme.desc: It’s time to get warm and fire up some soup. Pantry Minestrone makes a veggie-loaded comfort soup using almost entirely canned or frozen pantry ingredients. We’re also going to show you how to make a beautiful homemade chicken stock.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Special
programme.desc: Noah walks us through making his Smoked Turkey Gravy recipe. Get a jump start on Thanksgiving and make your stock in advance! Saving yourself the headache the day of.

programme.title: 4th of July Remixed
programme.desc: It’s 4th of July and Chef Dale is ready to celebrate by grilling up his takes on summer bbq classics, like his galbi smash double cheeseburger with kimchi special sauce, honey butter steak fries, and char sui bbq ribs.

programme.title: It's Taco Time
programme.desc: Tacos are the way to Chef Dale’s heart, and to prove it, he’s grilling up a sweet and smoky lemongrass and guajillo pork with pineapple, served with coconut and cotija cheese corn and an avocado jicama salad.

programme.title: Restaurant-Style Whole Roast Fish
programme.desc: Grilling isn’t only about fast and casual dinners. Chef Dale grills to impress with this elegant, restaurant quality meal of whole roasted fish, coconut milk grits, and snow pea, watermelon and tamarind salad.

programme.title: The Chicken Episode
programme.desc: If you’re going to grill chicken, you’ll want to make it good. Chef Dale likes to kick up the heat with his angry chicken, a spicy, spatchcocked and grilled whole chicken, and his kung pao chicken wings.

programme.title: Brunch On The Grill
programme.desc: Wake up, it’s time to grill! Chef Dale greets the day with a showstopping dutch baby pancake and tangerine syrup, crispy hash browns topped with creme fraiche and roe, and a ham steak smothered in sweet cherry mostarda and red eye gravy.

programme.title: Vegetables, But Delicious
programme.desc: Grilling is the perfect way to imbue your veggies with deliciousness. Chef Dale crafts a family style platter of trumpet mushrooms, eggplant marinated in spicy ssam jang, and charred yellow squash served with a green goddess dressing.

programme.title: Kabobs and Skewers
programme.desc: Kabobs and skewers are a family tradition for Chef Dale. This Mediterranean-inspired meal features beef and shrimp kabobs with grilled tomatoes, potatoes, and eggplant, all served on warm pita with a tangy white sauce.

programme.title: End of Summer Seafood Feast
programme.desc: The end of summer is near, and Chef Dale goes out in style with a giant seafood feast! Lobster, crab, clams, shrimp, and scallops, all served directly on the table with plenty of buttery garlic bread. Thanks for watching, and until we grill again!

programme.title: Apocalypse Burgers
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde kicks the summer off right with a burger blowout featuring Brisket Burgers with Grilled Onions and Blue Cheese, Shrimp Burgers with XO Sauce and a Fried Egg, and Lamb Sliders with Feta Ranch and don’t forget the Lemon Oregano Fries.

programme.title: Sausage Egg & Cheese All Day Long
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings out the best of brunch with sweet and savory hits such as Bacon Wrapped Dates Stuffed with Chorizo, Maple Sausage, Egg, & Cheese Fried Rice, and the tastiest BBQ Duck, Egg, & Corn Scallion Pancake Sandwiches you’ve ever eaten.

programme.title: Summer Surf 'n' Turf
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde kicks lobster & steak to the curb as he puts a Spanish-style spin on your typical surf ‘n’ turf by creating Pork & Clams, Lobster and Mushroom Fideos, and Tomato & Tuna Bread then washing it all down with a tasty Michelada.

programme.title: Perfectly Prepared Steaks
programme.desc: Big Daddy Dale Talde shows you how to marinate, prep, & grill up the biggest and best steaks out there. From a Hanger Steak with Salsa Verde to a Ribeye with Ginger Chili Relish, and tops it all off with the father of all steaks… The Porterhouse.

programme.title: Pizza Party on the Grill
programme.desc: It’s Pizza Time! Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas & Potatoes, and gives your childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much needed upgrade.

programme.title: Grill These Sandwiches
programme.desc: Mad Good Food Host Derrell Smith joins Chef Dale Talde at the grill as they cook up some stupendous sandwiches including a Salmon Pastrami Reuben, a Meatball Banh Mi, and even some Grilled Ice Cream Sandwiches.

programme.title: Beef Shank is the New Brisket
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor’s Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.

programme.title: The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They’re pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.

programme.title: Why LA’s "Danger Dog" is the Best Thing You’ll Ever Eat
programme.desc: Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.

programme.title: These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.

programme.title: The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You’ll Ever Need
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.

programme.title: New Orleans-Style Shrimp & Oysters
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings us to the bayou as he creates a NOLA-inspired menu complete with Chargrilled Oysters, Black Pepper Shrimp Po’boys, finishes it off with Bananas Foster, and washes it all down with a Fruity Grilled Hurricane.

programme.desc: From the funniest feline fails, to the cutest of kittens we've dug out the very best the internet has to offer, and we've the cream of the crop right here.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: At an address in the Wirral, Inspector Anthony Joynes finds two collie crosses, Patch and Socks. Both dogs are in very poor condition and Anthony needs to get them out. Inspector Herchy Boal is called to Scooby's rescue. She's collapsed with puncture wounds after fighting with two other dogs. Scooby is in shock so she needs urgent medical care.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: What items should a novice cat owner prepare to welcome their cat home? Recommendation of the best breeds for beginners among all cute cats! Eat like a champion cat by following healthy recipes we reveal! Don’t be afraid if you have a destructive cat at home, a trainer will help you understand your cat’s out-of-control behavior, Angelic Cat Training Class has begin! When the owner goes on a trip, felines will have a great vacation at the cat hotel!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt is called in to help wildlife rescuer Jean Thorpe care for three abandoned baby hedgehogs, a species whose numbers are dropping alarmingly. When they're ready for release, he offers them a home in his garden.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In London, an underweight, heavily pregnant dog has been brought into the Blue Cross Animal hospital by its owner. The mum to be needs emergency surgery to deliver her pups and because of her poor condition Inspector Annie Simmonds has been called in to investigate. Will Bailey and her pups make it through the operation?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep6

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep7
programme.desc: Ep07 Daniel marah kerana pembanteras jenayah melalkukan kerja polis dengan menangkap penjenayah-penjenayah. Tanpa dia ketahui itu adalah kerja ibunya sendiri. programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep8
programme.desc: Ep08 Daniel menyesaki ibunya menyembunyikan sesuatu. Roz pula menyelinap masuk pengkalan operasi Gagak Putih dan telah diserang. Roz berdepan dengan kesilapan masa silamnya sebagai seorang ibu, isteri dan ejen perisik, yang kini kembali untuk memusnahkan keluarganya.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Eps 01 Roz menjalani kehidupan normal sebagai seorang opah setelah pencen dari kerjaya lamanya iaitu ejen perisik. Suatu hari, cucunya Rin, telah menggodam satu permainan komputer dan dia dihubungi oleh seorang misteri dalam talian yang mengetahui identiti Rin. Roz mengesyaki sesuatu tidak kena, tapi malangnya Rin telah diculik oleh penjahat misteri tersebut sebelum Roz sempat bertindak.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Ep02 Roz cuba menenangkan Indah yang risaukan Rin dan Daniel yang telah mulakan penyiasatan. Namun Daniel tidak mahu mendengar nasihat ibunya, Roz. Daniel dan Roz menggunakan cara berbeza untuk mencari Rin. Pihak polis menerima rakaman pesanan suara Rin.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E45 - Charles A Portrait A Man Alone
programme.desc: This tells the tale of a man juggling the stress of his public obligations with the challenges of a failing marriage that's playing out in front of the world. It's a special look at the man fated to become King.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E03 - One Rhino at a Time
programme.desc: Mientras visita un orfanato secreto que cuida de crías de rinoceronte rescatadas, Ivan descubre la sangre, el sudor y las lágrimas que se emplean en salvar a esta especie en peligro de extinción. Una llamada de emergencia le lanza a la aventura con un grupo de héroes locales para salvar al próximo rinoceronte huérfano.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S02:E07 - Flying High
programme.desc: The Tanalian bush pilots transport extreme paragliders to Moose Creek, in the Talkeetna Range, for a once-in-a-lifetime airborne experience.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S02:E08 - On Thin Ice
programme.desc: En un raro día libre, Josiah y sus amigos practican rafting donde pocos lo han hecho antes: en la cima del enorme glaciar Knik.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E09 - Operation Mac Pass
programme.desc: In this episode, the Wardens get a Tip-Mont call about some elk that were taken illegally and go after the suspects.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E10 - Operation Paddlefish
programme.desc: This week, our Wardens are out in Montana keeping an eye on the rivers as folks go paddlefishing, and we're also trying to get rid of a troublesome bear from someone's property.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E07 - The Journal
programme.desc: En lo que se considera una de las mayores historias de supervivencia del siglo XX, el marinero Steven Callahan se encuentra solo y a la deriva en una balsa salvavidas después de que su barco, el Napoleon Solo se hunda en pleno Atlántico.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E10 - Adrift Part 2
programme.desc: Enfrentado al hambre, la deshidratación y los depredadores de las profundidades, el marinero Steven Callahan lucha por sobrevivir no sólo a las dificultades físicas, sino también a la tensión mental y emocional de estar a la deriva y solo en una balsa salvavidas que se desintegra.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E10 - Urban Prospectors
programme.desc: Tom y Kia buscan oro en el corazón de la ciudad.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E01 - A Family Affair
programme.desc: En los remotos rincones de la sabana de Alaska hay recompensas sin igual. Áspera, cruda y ahora cocinada, ésta es la última frontera culinaria donde un chef está redefiniendo lo que significa comer como un salvaje. Los clientes quisquillosos, los cambios climáticos bipolares y la escasez de alimentos y suministros a menudo llevan a Bradley al límite de su cordura, pero este espíritu creativo y libre siempre cumple.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E01 - Diana A Portrait
programme.desc: 黛安娜，威爾士公主，真是令人著迷，並在她的時代留下了與其他女性不同的印記。作為童話公主、關心丈夫的妻子和時尚開創者，這部紀錄片探索了更深的意義，以揭示在持續的公眾關注背後的真實人。

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E09 - Chris Moments
programme.desc: Seeing life through the lens of the camera

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E10 - Behind The Scenes
programme.desc: Relive all the memorable highlights from Dropped Seasons 1-8 as we dive behind-the-scenes.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E03 - Deadman's Survival
programme.desc: Island Air lucha contra el tiempo y los elementos, para rescatar a un grupo atrapado en Deadman's Bay.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E06 - Training Day
programme.desc: Island Air es el salvavidas de muchos en Kodiak. A veces, las violentas condiciones meteorológicas impiden que los aviones aterricen, así que Erik aprovecha el día para enseñar a Pete a utilizar la escotilla de la cámara para practicar un poco el tiro al blanco.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E01 - Into the High Lonesome
programme.desc: Laramy Sasquatch Miller emprende El Camino con su fiel caballo 7, para poner a prueba sus habilidades de supervivencia y rendir homenaje a los hombres de montaña del pasado. Al despedirse de su familia, Laramy y 7 tienen que luchar contra los elementos, construir refugios, vivir de la tierra y sobrevivir a una travesía de 30 días por el interior del país.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E05 - Surviving a Lightning Strike
programme.desc: Laura y Nick determinan el poder que tienen los rayos y cómo se comportan en un Laboratorio de Pruebas de Rayos de Efectos Directos de última generación. Ofrecen consejos a cazadores y pescadores para protegerse de ellos.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E06 - ATV Accidents
programme.desc: Laura y Nick preparan unas espectaculares pruebas de ATV a alta velocidad para ver cómo se producen los accidentes y qué hacer para protegerse de los daños.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E07 - Treestand Accidents
programme.desc: Explorando por qué ocurren los accidentes de treestand y cómo prevenirlos.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E08 - Surviving Nature's Fury
programme.desc: Nick Mundt y Laura Schara experimentan la furia de la Naturaleza a través de asombrosos equipos generadores de tormentas que simulan terribles huracanes, vientos helados e incluso tornados. Para estos experimentos utilizarán la extraordinaria tecnología que crea enormes tormentas en los platós de Hollywood.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E01 - Lost!
programme.desc: Nick and Laura subject themselves to intense survival training with the Survival Training School of California deep in the mountains.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E10 - Soul of a Survivor
programme.desc: Craig DeMartino examina las historias de otros supervivientes que ha conocido a lo largo de la temporada. Sus historias de supervivencia son todas diferentes, pero Craig descubre que estos supervivientes comparten más cosas en común de lo que se podría pensar.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E01 - Volcanoes
programme.desc: El mayor espectáculo del mundo es también el más feroz. Desperate Hours analiza la fuerza destructiva de los volcanes y examina las erupciones de Montserrat, que devastó media isla caribeña, la erupción de 1973 en la isla islandesa de Heimaey, la erupción de 2010 del Eyjafjallajökull, que bloqueó el tráfico aéreo en Europa, la erupción del Merapi en Indonesia y del monte Nyiragongo en el Congo, y el supervolcán de Yellowstone.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E02 - Earthquake
programme.desc: Cuando la Tierra se mueve de verdad, significa un desastre a escala épica. Horas desesperadas analiza la fuerza destructiva de los terremotos y se fija en el terremoto de Katmandú (Nepal) de 2015, el terremoto de Sichuan (China) de 2008, en el que se calcula que 10.000 niños quedaron atrapados en edificios escolares derrumbados, el terremoto de Puerto Mont (Chile) de 1960, el terremoto de Puerto Príncipe (Haití) de 2010 y el terremoto de Cachemira (Pakistán) de 2005.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E03 - Epidemic
programme.desc: Desperate Hours analiza grandes epidemias como el brote africano de ébola en Sudán, que acabó provocando casos en Estados Unidos e Inglaterra, el brote indio de viruela en Bihar, el brote africano de cólera, el brote de SARS en Guanghzhou (China) y la gripe aviar de Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E01 - Into the High Lonesome
programme.desc: Laramy Sasquatch Miller emprende El Camino con su fiel caballo 7, para poner a prueba sus habilidades de supervivencia y rendir homenaje a los hombres de montaña del pasado. Al despedirse de su familia, Laramy y 7 tienen que luchar contra los elementos, construir refugios, vivir de la tierra y sobrevivir a una travesía de 30 días por el interior del país.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E05 - Surviving a Lightning Strike
programme.desc: Laura y Nick determinan el poder que tienen los rayos y cómo se comportan en un Laboratorio de Pruebas de Rayos de Efectos Directos de última generación. Ofrecen consejos a cazadores y pescadores para protegerse de ellos.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E06 - ATV Accidents
programme.desc: Laura y Nick preparan unas espectaculares pruebas de ATV a alta velocidad para ver cómo se producen los accidentes y qué hacer para protegerse de los daños.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E07 - Treestand Accidents
programme.desc: Explorando por qué ocurren los accidentes de treestand y cómo prevenirlos.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E08 - Surviving Nature's Fury
programme.desc: Nick Mundt y Laura Schara experimentan la furia de la Naturaleza a través de asombrosos equipos generadores de tormentas que simulan terribles huracanes, vientos helados e incluso tornados. Para estos experimentos utilizarán la extraordinaria tecnología que crea enormes tormentas en los platós de Hollywood.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E01 - Lost!
programme.desc: Nick and Laura subject themselves to intense survival training with the Survival Training School of California deep in the mountains.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E02 - The Fergie Story Paradise Lost
programme.desc: 當安德魯王子和莎拉·費格森結婚時，她很快就成為自1385年創建這個頭銜以來最受歡迎的約克公爵夫人之一。

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E04 - Elephant Country
programme.desc: Ivan joins the foremost anti-poaching team in Mozambique to bring down one particular group of poachers who have been killing local elephants for their ivory.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E01 - Edge Of The Earth
programme.desc: 在第一集中，克里斯和凯西瞥見他們冒險的預期。它涵蓋了他們將要探索的地形類型、他們將遇到的天氣以及他們將使用的狩獵方法。此外，它深入探討了這個項目的背景及其起源。

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E11 - Operation Interstate Game Check
programme.desc: In this episode the Wardens set up a game checkpoint to make sure everyone is following the rules.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E12 - Operation Chuck Coal
programme.desc: Working in remote areas to safeguard our precious natural resources means every day on the job is exciting.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E01 - Nightmare Canyon Part 1
programme.desc: El descenso de fin de semana de Justin y Jeremy Harris a un remoto cañón de Utah se convierte en una pesadilla de supervivencia cuando Justin se rompe gravemente una pierna. A medida que se acerca la noche y las temperaturas descienden por debajo del punto de congelación, ¿cómo sobrevivirán estos dos hermanos?

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E02 - Nightmare Canyon Part 2
programme.desc: Parte 2: El fin de semana de escalada de Justin y Jeremy Harris ha resultado en un serio peligro para los hermanos. Con Justin totalmente incapacitado cuando se rompe la pierna le toca a Jeremy ir solo y tratar de conseguir ayuda. A medida que cae la noche y las temperaturas descienden hasta el punto de congelación, el tiempo es crítico para que los hermanos sobrevivan.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E02 - Surfers' Delight
programme.desc: En la cocina de pruebas definitiva del Planeta, este episodio sirve una cena especial para un grupo de surfistas, pero se avecina una tormenta. Será una cena para recordar. En el menú, una ensalada verde mixta con vinagreta de frambuesa, gelatina de pescado blanco con pepino y salsa de maíz, seguido de fletán a la plancha y polenta.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E03 - Hunters Paradise
programme.desc: Catering fuera de la red no es fácil y la familia Ewing lo sabe. A un grupo de 8 cazadores se les servirá una ensalada de remolacha seguida de estofado de venado y de postre tarta de queso con arándanos rojos.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E04 - Elizabeth At 80 Continuity And Change
programme.desc: Thanks to the Queen’s dedication, Britain found a way to move past its empire days and create a successful new identity, surprising many experts. This is the story of an amazing woman and her amazing life.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E05 - Capturing the Wild
programme.desc: Después de ver la desaparición de animales salvajes en el norte de África, Ivan se une a un equipo de captura de élite para ver cómo se captura, compra y vende la vida salvaje. Este "comercio de vida salvaje" es un modelo de negocio innovador que podría cambiar por completo la cara de la conservación en África.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E02 - On Top Of The World
programme.desc: Chris and Casey trudge through a bunch of streams, wade through long patches of soggy muskeg, and climb a mountain while searching for a big caribou bull. During the journey, Chris hurts his knee again, making him wonder if he’ll be able to continue the hunt.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E03 - Down The River
programme.desc: The guys head downstream looking for Yukon Bull Moose, spending two days traveling nearly 20 miles along the river. Chris and Casey keep going until they set up their moose camp. The new spot is a bit unsettling because they hear a grizzly just outside their tent.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E04 - Operation Antelope Dummy
programme.desc: 隨著普朗霍恩羚羊的數量下降，第7區的守護者在賽季開始前設置了一個誘餌突襲，但主要問題似乎是在開幕日進入的事故。而同時，第4區的守護者布萊恩·戈利接到了關於可能的偷獵事件的電話。

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E13 - Operation Wardens
programme.desc: 在國家最偏遠的地區努力保護我們珍貴的自然資源意味著在工作中永遠不會有無聊的日子。

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E03 - Under the Desert Sun
programme.desc: Ed Rosenthal emprendió una corta caminata en el Parque Nacional Joshua Tree, pero en el calor del día se dio la vuelta y se perdió. Sus seis días de supervivencia a temperaturas abrasadoras, sin comida ni agua, son casi milagrosos.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E04 - Treestand Nightmare
programme.desc: Cuando el Dr. Joe Baumgardner, ávido cazador con arco, se dispone a realizar el mantenimiento rutinario de sus puestos en los árboles, una caída de seis metros le deja con una pierna gravemente rota y a kilómetros de ayuda en los profundos bosques de Mississippi.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E04 - Celebration
programme.desc: Otra comida de 5 estrellas de la familia Ewing. Esta vez se trata de una cena para algunos nativos locales. Bradley decide ir a la caza de una cabra para el primer plato de ragú de cabra estofado a fuego lento, seguido de un risotto de pescado, y para el plato principal - cabra al curry con manzana y chutney de escaramujo y para completar la cena una tarta de lava fundida de chocolate de postre.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E05 - Fisherman's Catch
programme.desc: Bradley quiere ofrecer a un grupo de pescadores una cena inusual, algo totalmente inesperado. En el menú: caracoles de mar seguidos de un ambicioso plato de pepinos de mar y como plato principal un risotto de cangrejo Dungeness.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy
programme.desc: 反思戴安娜公主的遺產，這個節目深入探討了她在突然去世後留下的遺產——她對孩子們、皇室以及愛她的人留下的印象。年輕的王子們在她的葬禮上因其舉止贏得了讚譽，但許多人質疑他們與查爾斯王子的關係未來將會如何發展。

programme.title: The Story of Love
programme.desc: Ruby，一位有抱負的浪漫小說作家，為了獲得有利可圖的書籍合約，參加了她的文學英雄和當下最熱門作家Marcus Harlow在塔霍主持的一個寫作研討會。但當戶外型酒店老闆Woody向她展示大自然的美麗時，Ruby開始懷疑自己是否寫了錯誤的故事來打動像Marcus這樣的人。

programme.title: Mommy's Stolen Memories
programme.desc: 馬洛里的生活在她年幼的兒子比利被當地攀岩健身房的一位陌生女子吸引後顛倒過來。比利拒絕透露她說了什麼，並開始行為不端。

programme.title: Killer Cover Up
programme.desc: 全明星足球運動員珍娜·西姆斯和她的母親莎莉準備在搬到新陽光海灘城鎮後，迎接新的開始。但當她新足球隊的其他成員開始接連死亡，而其中一人落入昏迷之中時，珍娜發現自己被指控為兇手。

programme.title: Hashtag Proposal
programme.desc: 在兩個陌生人之間的假結婚求婚。當所有注意力開始幫助他們解決艱難的生活和事業時，Millie 和 Leo 假裝扮演，試圖忽視他們的感情。

programme.title: Rear View Mirror
programme.desc: 一位年輕的母親試圖逃離她控制且虐待的丈夫，在一個理想化、寧靜的海灘小鎮開始新的生活。

programme.title: Danger Rocks the Cradle
programme.desc: Nicolette, a high school senior has bounced around from foster home to home. She started feeling hopeless when found herself pregnant by the school quarterback.

programme.title: Secret Lives of College Escorts
programme.desc: 伊芙和朋友偷偷跑去參加派對，但朋友卻不幸喪命，而伊芙也失去了大學獎學金。很快，她找到一份工作以支付學費，但這份工作卻是導致她朋友死亡的危險伴遊計劃的掩護。

programme.title: Sparks Over Brooklyn
programme.desc: Single mom and chef Lidia sees her dreams for the future falling apart when arrogant tech innovator Danny buys her beloved family restaurant with plans to turn it into a busy dining experience.

programme.title: Home for a Royal Heart
programme.desc: When the seaside town of Shaw Bay is under threat of a redevelopment, realtor Erin will do anything to save it. Cue the handsome Theo, a royal looking for a new property. The catch is, he's hiding the royal part.

programme.title: Mommy's Stolen Memories
programme.desc: 馬洛里的生活在她年幼的兒子比利被當地攀岩健身房的一位陌生女子吸引後顛倒過來。比利拒絕透露她說了什麼，並開始行為不端。

programme.title: Sister Dating Swap
programme.desc: 當姊妹海倫娜和瑞秋對她們的愛情和工作感到厭倦時，她們同意交換住所兩周。然而，這場假期卻讓她們對工作、生活，最重要的是對戀愛有了全新的看法。

programme.title: Been There All Along
programme.desc: After her public breakup, Charley, determined founder of a dating app, is near bankruptcy and teamed up with Liam, a self-assured and innovative marketing expert, to save her company.

programme.title: Candid About Love
programme.desc: 勞拉是一名畫廊助理和渴望成為當代藝術攝影師的人，最終承諾獲得新人的展示位置 - 但前提是她能讓隱居的藝術家香農在畫廊首發他最新的攝影作品。當勞拉發現香農十年來沒有拍攝過新照片時，她決心無論香農是否想讓她幫忙，仍然要幫他找回對藝術的熱情。

programme.title: Conflict of Love Interest
programme.desc: 斯嘉麗以她的約會冒險而聞名，決定幫助她那永遠單身的朋友珍妮在愛情方面取得突破。然而，當她們合作時，斯嘉麗開始對那個可能是珍妮完美伴侶的男孩產生情感。

programme.title: Threats From The Inside
